desc: Implement input reading for N, X, Y, and strings S, T.
Write the two-pointer greedy simulation, handling edge cases when near the end of S.
After processing, output "Yes" if transformation is possible, otherwise "No".
Precompute run lengths of consecutive identical characters in S to allow O(1) skip checks.
Refactor greedy loop to use precomputed runs: when S[i] != T[j], look up the current run length and skip it if it matches the required block size (X for '0' run, Y for '1' run), otherwise fail.
Test on provided samples and edge cases (N=1, X=Y=1, X or Y equals N, large N, all same character).
Confirm `right_run` handles runs extending to end of string correctly.
Ensure final solution runs in O(N) time and fits constraints (N up to 5e5).
